displayName: Copilot Studio Agent -> Identity / Bot Map
description: Maps each Copilot Studio agent to its bot/runtime identifier (the UserId prefix that appears in AppEvents, e.g. pva-studio<botid>) and, where applicable, the Entra identity it acts under. Provides friendly agent names for the AppEvents UserId values and a hook for future cross-table correlation hunts (joining AppEvents to AuditLogs / OfficeActivity / AzureActivity). Populate BotId with the value seen in the AppEvents UserId column and AgentName with the human-friendly agent name.
